summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K announcing the issuance of senior unsecured notes: US$2.5bn 5.243% fixed/floating notes due 2032, US$3.25bn 5.729% fixed/floating notes due 2037, and US$1.0bn floating rate notes due 2032, under an existing indenture. The offering was made pursuant to an effective shelf registration statement on Form F-3, and listing on the NYSE will be sought. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No special-situation categories apply.
